title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_alice_nel_paese_delle_meraviglie_by_lewis_carroll_x9gkl (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_alice_nel_paese_delle_meraviglie_by_lewis_carroll_x9gkl' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
